# VoiceServerEqualizer

*Server*

Configures one client voice profile with pitch, ten equalizer bands, optional high pass and low pass filters, and distortion. Server player.getVoiceEqualizer() controls that player's microphone before encoding; getVoiceEqualizerFor(listener) controls playback of that speaker only on the listener's client. On a client player, getVoiceEqualizer() controls the local microphone and getVoiceEqualizer(speakerUUID) controls local playback. Microphone and playback profiles compose in that order. Gains are in decibels and frequencies are in Hz. Handles for the same profile share settings; changes take effect on subsequent client PCM frames. Disabled effects leave the native voice audio unchanged. Settings are not persisted.

## Methods

### getPresets {#getpresets}

::: member

Lists the available preset names.

**Returns** `String[]` — a new array containing normal, telephone, radio, megaphone and muffled

:::

### setPreset {#setpreset}

::: member

Replaces equalizer settings with a preset, including resetting the overall gain. Telephone and radio limit the voice bandwidth; megaphone emphasizes speech; muffled reduces high frequencies; normal restores the original equalizer settings. Presets do not change this profile's voice pitch or distortion.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | the preset name, ignoring case, not null |

:::

### reset {#reset}

::: member

Restores the original voice pitch, disables distortion and clears equalizer gains and filter history. Reverb settings are unchanged.

:::

### isEnabled {#isenabled}

::: member

Checks whether any setting changes the voice.

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if pitch, distortion, a filter or nonzero gain is active

:::

### getPitch {#getpitch}

::: member

Gets this profile's voice pitch multiplier.

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the multiplier, from 0.5 to 2.0; 1.0 is the original pitch

:::

### setPitch {#setpitch}

::: member

Changes this profile's voice pitch without changing frame duration. Values below 1.0 lower the voice; values above 1.0 raise it; 1.0 disables pitch processing and clears its delay history. Equalization and other effects are unchanged. Pitch runs before equalization and adds up to 50 ms of delay.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pitch` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | the finite pitch multiplier, from 0.5 to 2.0 |

:::

### getDistortion {#getdistortion}

::: member

Gets the proportion of distorted audio in the equalizer output.

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the distortion mix, from 0.0 to 1.0; zero disables distortion

:::

### setDistortion {#setdistortion}

::: member

Blends the voice with an overdriven, smoothly saturated signal, adding harmonics. Zero disables the effect; one outputs only the distorted signal. Distortion runs after frequency filters and before overall gain and reverb, without changing frame duration or generating noise in silence. It can increase loudness; use setGain() to adjust output volume. Pitch, filters and their history are unchanged.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `distortion` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | the finite distortion mix, from 0.0 to 1.0 |

:::

### getBandCount {#getbandcount}

::: member

Gets the number of adjustable bands.

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — ten bands, indexed from zero

:::

### getBandFrequency {#getbandfrequency}

::: member

Gets a band's center frequency.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `band` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | the zero based band index, from 0 to 9 |

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the center frequency in Hz

:::

### getBandGain {#getbandgain}

::: member

Gets the gain of one equalizer band.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `band` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | the zero based band index, from 0 to 9 |

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the gain in decibels

:::

### setBandGain {#setbandgain}

::: member

Changes one band's gain. Zero disables that band.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `band` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | the zero based band index, from 0 to 9 |
| `gain` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | the finite gain in decibels, from -24 to 24 |

:::

### getGain {#getgain}

::: member

Gets the overall output gain.

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the gain in decibels

:::

### setGain {#setgain}

::: member

Changes the overall output gain. Samples are clipped to the 16 bit PCM range.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gain` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | the finite gain in decibels, from -24 to 24 |

:::

### getHighPass {#gethighpass}

::: member

Gets the cutoff below which low frequencies are reduced.

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the cutoff in Hz, or zero if the high pass filter is disabled

:::

### setHighPass {#sethighpass}

::: member

Reduces frequencies below a cutoff.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `frequency` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | the finite cutoff in Hz, greater than 0 and less than 24000, or zero to disable; must be below an enabled low pass cutoff |

:::

### getLowPass {#getlowpass}

::: member

Gets the cutoff above which high frequencies are reduced.

**Returns** [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) — the cutoff in Hz, or zero if the low pass filter is disabled

:::

### setLowPass {#setlowpass}

::: member

Reduces frequencies above a cutoff.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `frequency` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | the finite cutoff in Hz, greater than 0 and less than 24000, or zero to disable; must be above an enabled high pass cutoff |

:::
